Assignment #02.name: Food Origin Filter Function Testing
Assignment #02.code:
# Constants
FILE = "foods.txt"
MODE = "r"
ENCODING = "utf8"

TESTS = [
    (-1, 100, False),
    (-1, 100, True),
    (-1, 200, False),
    (-1, 200, True),
    (7, 300, False),
    (7, 300, True),
    (0, 0, False),
    (0, 0, True),
    (-1, 0, False)
]

# Setup
file = open(FILE, MODE, encoding=ENCODING)
foods = read_foods(file)
file.close()

# Testing
for origin_id, max_calories, is_vegetarian in TESTS:
    if origin_id == -1:
        origin = "Any"
    else:
        origin = Food.ORIGIN[origin_id]
        
    if max_calories == 0:
        max_calorie_string = "Infinite"
    else:
        max_calorie_string = f"{max_calories}"
        
    if not is_vegetarian:
        is_vegetarian_string = "Any"
    else:
        is_vegetarian_string = "Yes"
        
    print(f"Searching for foods:")
    print(f"Origin: {origin}")
    print(f"Max Calories: {max_calorie_string}")
    print(f"Is Vegetarian: {is_vegetarian_string}")
    
    search_results = food_search(foods, origin_id, max_calories, is_vegetarian)
    food_table(search_results)
    
    for food in search_results:
        if origin_id != -1:
            assert food.origin == origin_id, f"Expected: {origin_id}, Actual: {food.origin}"
            
        if max_calories != 0:
            assert food.calories <= max_calories, f"Expected: {max_calories}, Actual: {food.calories}"
            
        if is_vegetarian:
            assert food.is_vegetarian == is_vegetarian, f"Expected: {is_vegetarian}, Actual: {food.is_vegetarian}"
        
    print()
